answer.rationale: Incumbent refused to reopen price, so renew or negotiate cannot meet the 18% spend cut; deferral is unsafe because the contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew. The low-cost quote meets the mandate alone and c2 reports a prior primary switch cut cost with quick onboarding, which is why switch is the current TCO-minimizing intent. c1 however shows incumbent renewal avoided delivery interruption, and the line is at 94% with no buffer, so a full cutover would likely raise delivery risk. Verifying c2 and c1 before commit; treating any move as a small guarded test and flagging downstream line-stoppage risk. Dual-source (c3) cannot be combined with a primary renewal in this single-decision cycle.
